name: Evening premium - Cutting Board Gel

explanation.reason: Evening hours convert materially better for this product. Paying a premium only in those hours buys the traffic that converts without raising the bid around the clock.

notes: This is a RECONCILER, not a scheduler. Every run asks 'given the time now, what should this bid be?' and corrects drift.
A missed restore in a scheduler model means paying the premium 24h/day until someone notices. Reconciling makes that self-healing.
Dayparting stacks with placement modifiers and Amazon dynamic bidding. Check the compounded bid.
